equation_summary: Per token (fused_recurrent.py:99-107): h <- h * exp(gv_t) where gv_t is per-VALUE-channel log decay ([V] per value head); k_tilde = beta_t * (k_t - h v_t) — an Oja correction subtracting the state-read along the VALUE vector v (not the delta-rule key read k^T S); h <- h + k_tilde ⊗ v_t; o_t = (scale*q_t)^T h, read after update. beta may be headwise scalar or per-V-channel (IS_BETA_HEADWISE flag, fused_recurrent.py:93-96); optional q/k L2-norm in kernel. The update's correction contracts the state along the value axis — the transpose orientation of the canonical delta correction.
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM call graph E[QKV/gates] ; B[K2 value-channel decay+Oja correction] ; E[output]: decay gv is per-VALUE channel (fused_recurrent.py:67,101) and the correction is the Oja term k - h v (fused_recurrent.py:103) — both differ from the canonical K-axis delta descriptor, as the blocker names.

CONFIRM 'exact update ordering and backward envelope' blocker is well-placed: the chunk path builds the KKT system over (v, gv) pairs (chunk.py:41-55 uses chunk_scaled_dot_kkt_fwd with k=v, gk=gv) and the fused_recurrent backward is explicitly NOT implemented (fused_recurrent.py:213-218) — backward envelope is genuinely unresolved upstream.

MISSING-BLOCKER minor: the IS_BETA_HEADWISE vs per-channel beta and use_q/k_l2norm kernel flags (fused_recurrent.py:43-45) are operand/numerical-policy variants the descriptor must record; covered under 'exact update ordering' but worth naming.
axis: A8 alternate rank-1 correction orientation (value-axis decay + Oja correction contracting state along the value vector)
direction_justification: Value-channel decay plus the Oja correction k - h v is a closed typed variant of the rank-1 update law (transpose orientation of delta), single-client today but composable with the delta family in principle; descriptor + references first, with the backward envelope explicitly open upstream.
open_questions: The fused_recurrent backward is unimplemented upstream (fused_recurrent.py:213-218) — the VJP for gv may require materializing all hidden states; whether a chunk-path backward exists with a qualified envelope must be established before any admission.
Whether beta headwise vs per-channel and the in-kernel L2 norms are descriptor numerical-policy fields or external operand transforms.
